text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhh!!!!
(Ooooohh...!?)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Is Epiphaneia... blowing past everyone...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
True, it really doesn't feel like she's holding back at all...
C-Can she keep it up...? Is she running wild again...!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Epi-senpai...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you know, wouldn't it be insane if we won like this?
Yeah, totally insane! I'm getting so excited...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Go! Go!! GOOO!!!!
Blow them all away, me!!

text_block_list.name: Voice of Destiny
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, charge ahead, no hesitation!! It's fine!
I already know! Master this power—and ride it!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You're right, "voice"!!
—Let's go together!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epi & Voice
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Epiphaneiaaaaaaaa!!
What incredible strength! This year's strongest has been decided!
Epiphaneia, a truly breathtaking victory!!!!
(Waaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Did you see that?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I am strong!
Destiny loves me!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Follow――Epiphaneia!!!!

Filled with joy, pride, and respect,
I give her the warmest round of applause.

The astonishing strength of Epiphaneia, which overwhelmed me when we first met—
shone at its absolute brightest today.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...What incredible power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"She possesses that much power...
...while I no longer do?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Utterly ridiculous!!
Even if I were to step aside... it will not be today.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Adorably, and powerfully!!
The day I win true to 'myself'—that will be the end."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, against this lineup,
she overwhelmed them with pure power...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is it! This is the run I've been waiting to see from Epiphaneia!! So awesome...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, Epi-senpai...!
It's so intense—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if I can run like that too.
Someday, on this very turf—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'm all right!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You can do it too! Believe in yourself!
After all, everything that raised you is right there within you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And—I am here too!
I'll push you forward, no matter how far!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Just now...—
After all the post-race duties were done... I received a message from Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I heard it too.
—The "voice of destiny."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That was...
your voice.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing your victory made my heart burn with passion...
Your powerful voice resonated deep within my soul."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Your voice, filled with conviction,
giving me that push from behind..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Epi-senpai, I... I can do my best. Because the pride of my hometown is right here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Amidst excitement like today's—I will definitely claim victory!!
I watch Daring Tact walk away, strength shining in her eyes—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah...!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I get it now!
A voice isn't something you awaken—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'll be the one to achieve it!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become "the voice itself"!
I'll become everyone's voice and push them forward!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll guide everyone toward happiness!
And—give them the strength to chase their dreams!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That was my...
"destiny."

Epiphaneia's dream had evolved.
The dream she believed in—to bestow destiny upon others...
was indeed something that could come true.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, did you hear it too?!
Eff!”

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry.
I am not quite sure what this is about...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see!!
So did you feel destiny at work!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Did watching me make you wanna run like me!?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...Of course.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
"I felt that I must run...
just like you."

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: If I can continue claiming victories like today's, I will leave behind achievements fully worthy of my family name.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thought so!
So, what're you gonna do after you build up your track record?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Of course you'll keep on running!
Just like me!!"

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know. All I care about
is achieving results befitting my family name."

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
That is all I must do—
the destiny I am meant to follow.
"She holds her mission—no, her destiny—in deep regard."

Therefore, her heart...
might be filled with nothing but the voice
urging her to fulfill her destiny.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Wait.
Then that's almost like—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's almost as if destiny
is holding you down, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, fate isn't... something to just bow down to.
—It's a blessing that lets you shine all the brighter!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...I cannot quite grasp what you mean.
choice_data_list: ...Epi, why not tell them the rest through your race?
...Epi, why not tell them the rest through your race?

text_block_list.text: Efforia's heart is locked away behind her fierce sense of duty. If I want to reach her, I must move her heart first.
choice_data_list: Let's show them a victory at the "Arima Kinen".

text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is the grand finale Grand Prix race of the year.
It's widely known even to non-racing fans, and naturally carries the hopes and dreams of so many people.

If she can witness Epiphaneia winning to fulfill
everyone's high expectations, joy, and dreams,
perhaps her heart might be moved.
choice_data_list: Eff, will you come watch the race?
Eff, are you coming to watch?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that won't be a problem.
However... I wonder if I can live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
The 'voice' that Epi-san speaks of...
is likely something I do not need.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That might be true.
Then again... maybe it isn't!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm being selfish!
And it's arrogant of me to think I can help you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, my voice will――
push you forward toward an even brighter light!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I'm certain of it!
...Won't you watch over me and see it through!?"

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!!
Wait for me at the Arima Kinen!
